description: Scrape Product Hunt launches via the official GraphQL API. Free API token required (https://api.producthunt.com/v2/oauth/applications).

apiToken.description: Optional Bearer token from https://api.producthunt.com/v2/oauth/applications (free, instant). Without a token, mode=dailyLeaderboard works via public-page scraping with limited fields (no description/makers/media). Token is required for topic, userLaunches, and productDetail modes, and unlocks full launch metadata in dailyLeaderboard.
apiToken.title: Product Hunt API token (optional)

dateRangeFrom.description: Drop launches posted before this date.
dateRangeFrom.title: Date range from (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateRangeTo.description: Drop launches posted after this date.
dateRangeTo.title: Date range to (YYYY-MM-DD)

featuredOnly.description: Only emit launches that were officially featured on the Product Hunt homepage.
featuredOnly.title: Featured only

includeMakers.description: Include the makers array (people who built the product). Adds 1 GraphQL field — minor cost.
includeMakers.title: Include makers

includeMedia.description: Include the media array (screenshots, videos uploaded with the launch).
includeMedia.title: Include media (screenshots / videos)

minComments.description: Drop launches with fewer comments than this.
minComments.title: Min comments

minVotes.description: Drop launches with fewer up-votes than this.
minVotes.title: Min votes

mode.description: What to fetch. `dailyLeaderboard` returns featured launches sorted by votes; `topic` returns launches in a specific topic; `userLaunches` returns posts by a user; `productDetail` returns a single product by slug.
mode.title: Mode

sortBy.description: Sort order for posts. RANKING is daily-rank order; VOTES is most-upvoted overall; NEWEST is most recent; FEATURED_AT is featured-date order.
sortBy.title: Sort by

tagAnyOf.description: Only emit launches that have at least one of these topic slugs (e.g. `productivity`, `saas`).
tagAnyOf.title: Tags / topics filter

topicSlugs.description: Topic slugs from Product Hunt URLs (e.g. `artificial-intelligence`, `developer-tools`, `productivity`). Required for `mode=topic`.
topicSlugs.title: Topic slugs (mode=topic)

userSlugs.description: Username slugs from Product Hunt URLs (e.g. `rrhoover`, `tibo_maker`). Required for `mode=userLaunches`.
userSlugs.title: User slugs (mode=userLaunches)

title: Product Hunt Scraper Input
